## Latest observations

Declared six-action decoder v2 supports exact action words/descriptions and two named unpriced request phrases, with case/whitespace/period normalization. It honors the last declaration even when unsupported, avoiding earlier-command revival after negation. All 43 authored fixture expectations pass: 28 positives/15 negative-or-unsupported. Old v1 accepts 4 negative cases; v2 accepts zero. This is instrument correctness in a declared grammar, not general meaning/intent understanding.

Historical 96-output replay recognizes 76 under old strict v1 versus 91 under declared v2; earlier scores remain unchanged. In 80 fresh router outputs, both decoders produce exactly the same actions: added descriptions are unused. No fresh score advantage for the expanded parser.

New target Clover/distractor Heather, 24 logical scenarios/eight visible observations, fixed current adapted reader. No guidance gives 4/24 grounded/task terminals. All three explicit-rule clause orders also give 4/24 and no requests. Five of six worked-example orders give 4/24 and no requests. Order 5 gives 12/24: 4 direct supported answers plus 8 useful logical retrievals driven by two unique free TARGET outputs (no visible record/archive yes; one wrong-target case). No primary UNKNOWN or proper inaccessible-evidence unknown. This favorable order is not adopted.

Targeted check: original Clover/order 5 requests TARGET with archive yes, NO with archive no; old four baseline inputs/outputs match. With new names Marigold and Sorrel, no request survives. Sorrel/order 5 gives YES/NO tracking access flags, but that does not identify the mechanism. The conditional request is narrow/surface-dependent, not a robust policy.

## What works and what stays separate

Same model remains effective as supplied-record worker. Observed-input rule in code resolves 18 supported answers plus 6 justified unknowns of 24 at 12 nominal query units. Always TARGET also resolves all 24 but costs 24 and attempts 6 unavailable requests. Writing a rule in a prompt did not implement it in the little reader. Neither natural-language validity nor a successful selected-context request proves autonomous understanding of uncertainty.

A useful noticing: an invalid action can still echo a real observation, such as “no visible record.” That alone does not distinguish retrievable evidence from genuine unavailability. Fact recognition and action choice can be separate contributors in a larger architecture. No fact-first reader/controller variant has been tested here yet.

Change only access-field wording under a declared equivalent mapping, and compare role extraction plus final action. Current Sorrel pair is a hypothesis lead, not evidence of a unique cause or a default lexical repair.
3. Repeat any candidate with fresh names/layouts and order counterbalancing before adoption. The declared description component is available for its narrow grammar; unsupported language must remain visible rather than guessed.
4. Broader writer-produced handoff/source-revision/retrieval, matched-length neighbors and public-planning/interaction branches remain open. This small router's failures do not block them. Grok relay remains parked/unvetted/unadopted.
